data.one_liner: Flutter package providing 2,029+ open-source icons from the Lucide icon set.
data.what_it_does: It provides access to a comprehensive library of clean, modern icons from the Lucide set inside Flutter applications. Icons can be easily rendered using standard Flutter Icon widgets with tree-shaking support for performance optimization.
use_when: You want to use Lucide icons in your Flutter application.
You need a large, consistent, open-source icon set alternative to Material or Cupertino.
avoid_when: You are already using an alternative icon package like font_awesome_flutter and want to keep dependency counts low.
strengths: Supports tree shaking to only include icons actually used.
Cross-platform support across Android, iOS, Web, macOS, Windows, and Linux.
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec.yaml and run pub get.

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the Font Awesome icon library instead of Lucide.

alternatives.name: lucide_icons_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: An alternative package providing Lucide icons for Flutter.
